units.angles: degrees for pod yaw/pitch/fan/lock angle; radians for the bomb spawn pitch/yaw
units.axes: Y up; 'left' = up x dir (robo facing -z: right is +x)

model.press: state 0: pod button while alive < max_alive -> robo state 5 for 10 ticks; launch on its first tick (press + 1); no cooldown beyond the alive count
model.launch: per_use pods (3 slots): pos = robo torso point (R+0x10D4 translation); s = stick dir (or the last facing), horizontal; vel = rotY(s, velocity_yaw) pitched up by pitch_deg about (heading x up), * launch_speed; heading = rotY(s, -heading_yaw)
model.launch_phase: launch_ticks ticks: pos += vel (no gravity, no homing)
model.homing_phase: lock test, heading turned toward the target by angle*turn_fraction, vel.xz = heading*speed (0 while pausing after a fresh lock), vel.y -= 0.003, pos += vel, life countdown
model.after_move: wall: remove (slide) or reflect the normal part of vel and heading; floor clamp; if not launching: vel.y += 0.01*((0.01*hover + 0.6 + floor) - y); vel.y *= 0.9
model.explode: proximity (horizontal radius, height window to the target's position R+0x20), life reaching 0, or leaving the arena circle

explosion.spawn: blast k spawns at tick k*blast_interval of the explosion, at E.pos + (0, 0.03, 0); E.pos += E.vel every tick (bomb: horizontal launch dir * 0.001*speed; pod: its velocity with y = 0)
explosion.radius: t <= grow: r = t*radius_peak/grow; else r = radius_peak + (t-grow)/shrink*(radius_end-radius_peak); blast ends when t > grow+shrink
explosion.hit: cylinder at the blast: horiz dist(target R+0x1DC, blast) < r + rho and |dy| < r*height_factor + rho, rho = 0.01 * body+0xAC of the robo that owns the attack (as read); once per blast per target
explosion.damage: damage * body factor (bomb: body+0x4D/100, pod: body+0x4E/100) added to target R+0x18B4; down added to R+0x18B6; hit_params -> R+0x18B8..; knockback dir = horizontal(target - blast)
explosion.model: explosion model scale (0.909 r, 0.909 r * 0.909 height_factor, 0.909 r), no rotation, at the blast pos; alpha multiplier 1, or (2 + remaining)/12 in the last 10 ticks (remaining = grow+shrink - t)

model.projectile_matrix: Z = heading (horizontal), X = norm(up x Z), Y = Z x X, uniform scale model_scale, at pos: the pod never pitches
model.projectile_anim: archive0 ModelSet0 restarted at launch, HSD rate 0.5, advanced once per tick in the update (and in draw pass 1 when 0x8044F5F0 is set)

effects.archive1_modelset0: explosion, one pool instance per blast (pool of 8 per player)
